title: When More Words Say Less: Decoupling Length and Specificity in Image Description Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper investigates the conflation of description length and specificity (verbosity bias) by constructing a dataset of image descriptions that controls for length while varying information content (e.g., 'verbose' vs. 'composite' descriptions). It evaluates whether human preferences and automated metrics track specificity or simply prioritize longer text.
